item.title: Understanding kW vs kWh: The EV Power & Energy Explained
item.description: Learn the difference between kW and kWh for electric vehicles, compared to horsepower and MPG, helping you understand EV performance and efficiency.

item.title: Electric Vehicles vs. Gas Cars: What You Need to Know
item.description: Discover the science behind EVs, from electric motors and lithium-ion batteries to regenerative braking. Learn how they compare to internal combustion engines (ICE) in performance, efficiency, and environmental impact. Dive into the future of clean, quiet, and sustainable driving!.

item.title: Why Trump’s Policies Could Accelerate EV Adoption and Strengthen Clean Tech Innovation
item.description: Despite concerns over Trump’s rollback of EV incentives, this moment presents a unique opportunity for the EV and clean tech industries to prove their intrinsic value—beyond government mandates and subsidies.

item.title: The Green Divide: How Income Inequality Shapes EV Adoption in Europe (Part 1)
item.description: Income inequality is a significant barrier to EV adoption in Europe, with low- and middle-income households unable to afford EVs priced at €40,000 or more. This article examines the challenges and potential solutions.

item.title: The Green Divide: How EU Policy Misalignment Creates Political Risk (Part 2)
item.description: The EU's contradictory approach to EV adoption—mandating a green transition while making EVs less affordable—threatens climate goals and fuels political instability. This article explores the role of tariffs, automaker strategies, and policy failures in shaping Europe's EV future.

item.title: The Climate Hunger Games: Why Spain's EV Policies Are Stacked Against Average Citizens
item.description: Spain's suspension of the MOVES III incentive program highlights the systemic dysfunction of EU climate policies. This article explores how bureaucratic hurdles, misaligned incentives, and political opposition are undermining the green transition, and what Spain can learn from Norway and Montana.

item.title: The Role of Content in EV and Clean Tech Sales
item.description: Discover how content can bridge the knowledge gap in EV and clean tech sales, empowering buyers and enabling sales teams.

item.title: NexisNeo in Transit Tomorrow: Understanding the EV Adoption Green Divide
item.description: NexisNeo founder featured in Transit Tomorrow's expert analysis on EV adoption barriers, highlighting how income inequality and affordability challenges create a 'green divide' in sustainable transportation.

item.title: EV Owner Insights: Real Experiences Comparing Electric and ICE Vehicles
item.description: Real EV owners share their experiences transitioning from ICE vehicles, revealing surprising insights about cost savings, performance, and convenience that could reshape how we sell electric vehicles.

item.title: The Green Transition: A Promise Unfulfilled—Why Europe’s Climate Goals Are Stalling and What Needs to Change
item.description: Europe's ambitious climate goals are stalling due to a lack of cooperation between governments and corporations. This article explores the challenges, policy contradictions, and the path forward for the green transition.
